description:
Markifact is a marketing automation and advertising management connector for ChatGPT. Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers, PPC specialists, growth teams, and in-house marketing teams who need cross-channel reporting, paid media analysis, and campaign management without switching between ad dashboards.

Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Pinterest Ads, Amazon Ads, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT ads), Display & Video 360 (DV360), Spotify Ads, Data Manager.

Analytics and data: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Trends, Google Search, BigQuery, SEMrush, Adjust, Bing Webmaster Tools, PageSpeed Insights.

E-commerce and CRM: Shopify, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and Google Merchant Center.

Workspace and reporting: Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs, Google Drive, Microsoft SharePoint (OneDrive), Dropbox, Google Business Profile, and Google Maps.

Social and messaging: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp.

Use Markifact for cross-channel advertising reports, PPC reporting, campaign audits, account monitoring, budget pacing, search term and keyword analysis, creative performance analysis, marketing data extraction, and campaign optimization. ChatGPT can retrieve campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, budgets, conversions, performance metrics, dimensions, and account structures from any connected account.

Markifact also supports advertising automation. Create campaigns and ads, update budgets and bids, pause or enable campaigns, edit supported ad fields, upload images and video, manage targeting, and run other platform-supported actions, then send results straight to Google Sheets, Slides, Docs, or Slack.

defaultPrompt: Update our Meta Ads with the new uploaded creatives
Analyze device performance for our summer Google Ads campaign
Show me what marketing actions I can run with Markifact
